title: Yavaş yürüyen

characters.MAN: a young man with wavy chestnut hair, wearing a rust-orange sweater and a canvas backpack

scenes.text:
Herkes koşuyor gibi görünür,
sen ise yürüyorsun.
scenes.prompt: On a country path in spring, {MAN} walks calmly while two cyclists speed past him in the distance, green fields, white clouds.
{MAN} stands on a hillside path watching small figures far ahead climbing to the top of the hill, soft spring light, wildflowers.
{MAN} stops at a fork in a forest path, looking thoughtfully at both ways, sunbeams through fresh green leaves.

scenes.text:
Ama yürürken her çiçeği,
her ağacı tanıyorsun.
scenes.prompt: {MAN} kneels on the path smiling at a small blue butterfly resting on a wildflower, spring meadow around him, gentle light.

scenes.text:
Acele etme.
Yol, onu tanıyana kendini açar.
scenes.prompt: {MAN} reaches the top of a green hill at golden hour and looks over a wide valley with a river and blossoming trees, peaceful smile.

caption:
Herkesin adımı farklıdır, yavaş yürümek de bir yürüyüştür. 🤍

Kendini geride hisseden birine gönder.
